name: Dried beef
summary: Khô bò is dried beef, the other half of the gift known as khô Châu Đốc. Travelers buy it with dried fish, mắm, palm sugar, and palm fruit.
origin: A Châu Đốc gift, paired with dried fish as khô Châu Đốc.
howToEat: Buy it to carry home with the other Châu Đốc gifts.
seoDescription: Khô bò is dried beef, half of the gift known as khô Châu Đốc, bought with dried fish, mắm, and palm sugar.
